code_set.hcc_model: PY2026 midyear final model software CMS-HCC software V2826.115.T1.zip (C2824T2N.csv, V28115H1.TXT)

topics.title: Chronic kidney disease
topics.description: CKD stages, hypertensive CKD and dialysis status.

topics.title: Diabetes
topics.description: Diabetes type, complications, the "with" convention and long-term drug use.

topics.title: Diabetes, hypertension and CKD
topics.description: All three together: the 'with' link, hypertensive CKD and the stage code.

topics.title: Dementia
topics.description: Dementia type, stage and behavioral disturbance; mild cognitive impairment.

topics.title: Depression
topics.description: Major depression: single or recurrent, severity, psychotic features and remission.

topics.title: Cancer
topics.description: Current cancer versus personal history, and metastases.

topics.title: Stroke after discharge
topics.description: History of stroke versus residual deficits; dominant and non-dominant side.

topics.title: Heart failure
topics.description: Heart failure type and acuity, and hypertensive heart disease.

topics.title: Atrial fibrillation
topics.description: Atrial fibrillation type, current versus history after ablation, and anticoagulant use.

topics.title: Obesity and BMI
topics.description: Obesity versus morbid obesity, and when BMI codes are reportable.

topics.title: Peripheral artery disease
topics.description: Atherosclerosis of the legs: claudication, rest pain, ulceration and the ulcer code.

topics.title: COPD and respiratory failure
topics.description: COPD, exacerbation or emphysema; chronic respiratory failure versus home oxygen alone.

topics.title: Pressure ulcers
topics.description: Pressure ulcer site and stage, unstageable versus unspecified, and healed ulcers.

topics.title: Liver disease
topics.description: Cirrhosis types and ascites, chronic versus cured hepatitis C, and fatty liver.

topics.title: Status codes
topics.description: Amputation and ostomy status: level, side, and reversed ostomies.

topics.title: Epilepsy, Parkinson's and MS
topics.description: Epilepsy and intractability, seizure disorder versus a past seizure, Parkinson's disease, MS type.

topics.title: Rheumatoid arthritis
topics.description: Rheumatoid arthritis versus osteoarthritis, rheumatoid factor, and methotrexate use.

topics.title: Alcohol use
topics.description: Alcohol use disorder severity and remission versus social drinking.

topics.title: MEAT documentation
topics.description: Which chronic conditions the note supports: assessed and treated, or only listed.

ckd_staging.title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
ckd_staging.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.

wrong_ckd_stage.description: Picked a different CKD stage than documented.

under_staged.description: Picked a lower or less specific stage than documented.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported a subcategory that needs more characters.

both_stage_and_esrd.description: Reported a CKD stage together with ESRD.

missed_htn_ckd_link.description: Coded hypertension and CKD separately instead of hypertensive CKD.

wrong_htn_ckd_code.description: Used the hypertensive CKD code for the wrong stage range.

diabetes_complications.title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
diabetes_complications.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.

values.no: No statement that it is unrelated
values.yes: Provider says it is NOT caused by the diabetes

missed_with_link.description: Did not apply the 'with' convention, which presumes the link between diabetes and listed conditions.

linked_despite_provider.description: Linked a condition to diabetes after the provider documented it is unrelated.

missed_code_also.description: Left out the additional code the Tabular instructs (e.g., CKD stage).

redundant_manifestation.description: Added a separate code for a manifestation already captured by the combination code.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported a category/subcategory that needs more characters.

missed_complication.description: Coded diabetes without complications when a complication was documented.

coded_unsupported_complication.description: Coded a diabetic complication that was not documented.

missed_med_status.description: Left out the long-term drug use Z code.

only_one_med_code.description: Assigned only one Z code when both insulin and oral hypoglycemics are used.

z794_for_type1.description: Assigned Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes, where insulin use is inherent.

coded_med_not_documented.description: Assigned a long-term drug use code that is not documented.

diabetes_htn_ckd.title: Diabetes, hypertension and CKD together
diabetes_htn_ckd.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.

missed_with_link.description: Coded diabetes without complications although the 'with' convention links diabetes and CKD.

missed_htn_ckd_link.description: Coded hypertension separately instead of hypertensive CKD.

wrong_htn_ckd_code.description: Used the hypertensive CKD code for the wrong stage range.

missed_code_also.description: Left out the CKD stage code that the combination codes ask for.

under_staged.description: Coded a lower CKD stage than documented.

dementia_severity.title: Dementia: type, stage and behavior
dementia_severity.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cognitive disorder.

missed_underlying.description: Left out the underlying condition (G30.9) that is coded first with dementia in other diseases (F02.-).

wrong_dementia_category.description: Used unspecified dementia (F03.-) when the dementia is due to Alzheimer's disease (F02.-).

assumed_severity.description: Coded a dementia stage the provider did not document.

missed_severity.description: Used an unspecified-severity code when the provider documented the stage.

wrong_severity.description: Coded a different stage than documented.

missed_behavior.description: Left out documented agitation (dementia with behavioral disturbance).

unsupported_behavior.description: Coded a behavioral disturbance that is not documented.

coded_dementia_for_mci.description: Coded dementia when the provider documented mild cognitive impairment.

depression_severity.title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
depression_severity.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.

severity_up.description: Coded a higher severity than documented.

severity_down.description: Coded a lower severity than documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used the unspecified code when the severity is documented.

assumed_severity.description: Coded a severity the provider did not document.

unsupported_psychotic.description: Coded psychotic features that are not documented.

remission_coded_active.description: Coded an active severity when the provider documented remission.

single_vs_recurrent.description: Confused a single episode with recurrent depression.

coded_mdd_without_documentation.description: Coded major depressive disorder when only 'depression' is documented.

cancer_status.title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
cancer_status.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.

values.history: Treated in the past, no evidence of it now

history_coded_active.description: Coded a current cancer after treatment ended with no evidence of the primary.

active_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the cancer is still being treated.

missed_mets.description: Left out a documented metastasis (secondary malignancy).

wrong_met_site.description: Coded the metastasis to the wrong site.

unspecified_laterality.description: Used an unspecified-side code when the side is documented.

stroke_sequelae.title: Stroke: history or residual deficits
stroke_sequelae.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's past stroke and any residual deficits.

coded_acute_stroke.description: Used an acute stroke code (I63.-) after the acute episode.

history_with_deficit.description: Coded personal history (Z86.73) when a residual deficit is documented.

sequela_without_deficit.description: Coded a stroke sequela when no residual deficit is documented.

wrong_dominance.description: Picked the wrong dominant or non-dominant side.

unspecified_side.description: Used an unspecified-side code when the side is documented.

heart_failure.title: Heart failure: type, acuity and hypertension
heart_failure.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any related hypertension.

missed_htn_hf_link.description: Coded hypertension and heart failure separately instead of hypertensive heart disease (I11.0).

acuity_down.description: Coded chronic heart failure when an acute-on-chronic exacerbation is documented.

acuity_up.description: Coded an acute exacerbation that is not documented.

acute_only.description: Coded acute heart failure when it is acute on chronic.

unspecified_hf.description: Used unspecified heart failure (I50.9) when type and acuity are documented.

wrong_hf_type.description: Confused systolic and diastolic heart failure.

atrial_fibrillation.title: Atrial fibrillation: type, history and anticoagulation
atrial_fibrillation.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's atrial fibrillation and related long-term drug therapy.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91) when the type is documented.

wrong_af_type.description: Coded a different type of atrial fibrillation than documented.

assumed_type.description: Coded a type of atrial fibrillation the provider did not document.

resolved_coded_current.description: Coded current atrial fibrillation after it was cured and is no longer treated.

current_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the atrial fibrillation is still current.

antiplatelet_vs_anticoagulant.description: Used the antiplatelet code (Z79.02) for an anticoagulant.

obesity_bmi.title: Obesity, morbid obesity and BMI
obesity_bmi.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's weight diagnosis and BMI, if reportable.

bmi_without_dx.description: Reported a BMI code without a provider-documented weight diagnosis.

obesity_from_bmi.description: Coded obesity from the BMI alone; the provider must diagnose it.

morbid_from_bmi.description: Upgraded the provider's 'obesity' to morbid obesity from the BMI.

missed_morbid.description: Coded obesity, unspecified when the provider documented morbid obesity.

missed_bmi.description: Left out the BMI code when it is reportable.

pad_atherosclerosis.title: Peripheral artery disease: stage, side and ulcer
pad_atherosclerosis.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's peripheral artery disease and any related ulcer.

assumed_atherosclerosis.description: Coded atherosclerosis or a complication that is not documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified PVD (I73.9) when atherosclerosis with a complication is documented.

understated_severity.description: Coded a lower stage of atherosclerosis than documented.

overstated_severity.description: Coded a higher stage of atherosclerosis than documented.

missed_ulcer_code.description: Left out the ulcer code (L97.-) that the atherosclerosis-with-ulceration code asks for.

copd_respiratory.title: COPD, respiratory failure and home oxygen
copd_respiratory.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's chronic lung disease and any respiratory failure or oxygen dependence.

values.oxygen_only: Home oxygen, no respiratory failure documented
values.chronic_failure: Chronic respiratory failure with hypoxia, on home oxygen

missed_exacerbation.description: Coded stable COPD when an acute exacerbation is documented.

unsupported_exacerbation.description: Coded an exacerbation that is not documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used COPD, unspecified (J44.9) when emphysema is documented.

respiratory_failure_from_oxygen.description: Coded respiratory failure from home oxygen use alone; the provider must diagnose it.

missed_oxygen.description: Left out dependence on supplemental oxygen (Z99.81).

missed_respiratory_failure.description: Left out documented chronic respiratory failure (HCC 213).

unspecified_respiratory_failure.description: Used unspecified respiratory failure when hypoxia is documented.

acute_on_chronic_unsupported.description: Coded acute on chronic respiratory failure when only chronic failure is documented.

pressure_ulcer.title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
pressure_ulcer.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.

unspecified_when_documented.description: Used the unspecified-stage code when the stage (or unstageable) is documented.

understated_stage.description: Coded a lower stage than documented.

overstated_stage.description: Coded a higher stage than documented.

assumed_stage.description: Coded a stage the provider did not document.

healed_coded.description: Coded a pressure ulcer that is completely healed.

liver_disease.title: Liver disease: cirrhosis, hepatitis C, fatty liver
liver_disease.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's liver disease.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified cirrhosis when alcoholic cirrhosis is documented.

assumed_cause.description: Coded a cause of cirrhosis the provider did not document.

missed_ascites.description: Left out documented ascites (alcoholic cirrhosis with ascites).

unsupported_ascites.description: Coded ascites that is not documented.

unspecified_hepatitis.description: Used unspecified viral hepatitis C instead of chronic hepatitis C.

current_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the hepatitis C is still present.

history_coded_active.description: Coded current hepatitis C after it was cured.

coded_cirrhosis.description: Coded cirrhosis when only fatty liver is documented.

status_codes.title: Amputation and ostomy status
status_codes.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM status codes this note supports.

missed_status.description: Left out a documented status that still applies.

attention_vs_status.description: Used an 'attention to' encounter code (Z43.-) instead of the status code (Z93.-).

wrong_ostomy.description: Confused a colostomy and an ileostomy.

reversed_coded.description: Coded an ostomy that was reversed.

neuro_conditions.title: Epilepsy, Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis
neuro_conditions.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's neurological condition.

values.single_seizure_history: One seizure years ago, none since

unsupported_intractable.description: Coded intractable epilepsy when it is not documented.

missed_intractable.description: Coded non-intractable epilepsy when intractable is documented.

symptom_for_diagnosis.description: Coded a seizure symptom (R56.9) instead of the documented diagnosis.

coded_resolved_seizure.description: Coded a current seizure condition for a single seizure years ago with no recurrence.

parkinsonism_vs_parkinsons.description: Used parkinsonism (G20.C) when Parkinson's disease is documented.

unsupported_fluctuations.description: Coded motor fluctuations that are not documented.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported G35, which needs more characters in FY2027.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used MS, unspecified when the type is documented.

assumed_type.description: Coded an MS type the provider did not document.

rheumatoid_arthritis.title: Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and methotrexate
rheumatoid_arthritis.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's arthritis and related long-term drug therapy.

coded_ra_for_oa.description: Coded rheumatoid arthritis when the provider documents osteoarthritis.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used rheumatoid arthritis, unspecified (M06.9) when rheumatoid factor and sites are documented.

assumed_rf_status.description: Coded rheumatoid factor status the provider did not document.

nonspecific_drug_code.description: Used 'other long-term drug therapy' (Z79.899) when a specific code exists.

alcohol_use.title: Alcohol use disorder: severity and remission
alcohol_use.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's alcohol use, if any is reportable.

coded_social_drinking.description: Coded alcohol use when the provider documents only social drinking.

severity_up.description: Coded dependence (F10.2-) for a mild use disorder.

severity_down.description: Coded abuse (F10.1-) for a moderate or severe use disorder.

missed_remission.description: Coded the disorder as active when it is in remission.

unspecified_use.description: Used 'alcohol use, unspecified' when a use disorder is documented.

meat_support.title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
meat_support.question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Choose 'no code' if none is supported.

values.med_list_only: A medication on the list only

missed_supported_condition.description: Did not code a chronic condition the provider monitored, evaluated, assessed or treated.

coded_without_meat.description: Coded a condition that only appears in a problem list or history without being addressed.

coded_from_med_list.description: Inferred and coded a diagnosis from a medication list.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when severity/type was documented.

hccs.18: Cancer Metastatic to Bone/Other and Unspecified Metastatic Cancer; Acute Leukemia Except Myeloid
hccs.93: Rheumatoid Arthritis and Other Specified Inflammatory Rheumatic Disorders
hccs.139: Alcohol Use Disorder/Moderate/Severe/Alcohol Use with Specified Non-Psychotic Complications
hccs.199: Parkinson and Other Degenerative Disease of Basal Ganglia
hccs.225: Acute Heart Failure (Excludes Acute on Chronic)
hccs.263: Atherosclerosis of Arteries of the Extremities with Ulceration or Gangrene
hccs.280: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease/Interstitial Lung Disorders/and Other Chronic Lung Disorders
hccs.379: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Necrosis Through to Muscle/Tendon/Bone
hccs.381: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Full Thickness Skin Loss
hccs.382: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Partial Thickness Skin Loss
hccs.383: Chronic Ulcer of Skin/Except Pressure/Not Specified as Through to Bone or Muscle
hccs.463: Artificial Openings for Feeding or Elimination
